up: List the molecules that are associated with the document having ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1150213. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Order the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Use the document identifier from the docs table to find the document, then link through compound_records to molecule_dictionary to get molecule details, and join with compound_structures to obtain the canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs JOIN compound_records cr ON docs.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150213' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
